newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraqi plane to Mecca in defiance of U.N. sanctions.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi plane to Mecca in defiance of U.N. sanctions.

text.p: An Iraqi plane carrying 104 pilgrims to Mecca flew to Saudi Arabia in defiance of U.N. sanctions barring international flights by Iraqi aircraft, witnesses said on Wednesday.
They said a Soviet-built Ilyushin 76 took off from Rasheed airbase in the eastern outskirts of the Iraqi capital on its way to Jedda airport in Saudi Arabia.
Senior Iraqi officials, including two ministers, took part in a farewell ceremony before the pilgrims took off on Wednesday.

Endowment and Religious Affairs Minister Abdul-Muneim Ahmed Saleh said the sending of the plane to Saudi Arabia despite the U.N. trade sanctions was ..."a humanitarian endeavour and had no other purpose in mind ... There may be some problems but the aim is humanitarian."
The aircraft's captain Muayyad Younis al-Dibourni said he hoped ... "our Arab brethren (in Saudi Arabia) will welcome the plane."
U.N. sanctions were imposed on Iraq after its 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
